_why: SHRINK-ONLY. Security boundaries that are registered but not yet wired, each naming the slice that will wire it. check-security-boundary-wired.mjs FAILS on any unwired boundary NOT listed here, and ALSO fails when a listed one becomes wired — a fixed entry must be deleted, so the list can only get shorter. Adding an entry is a deliberate act in a file whose name says what it means.

unwired.fixedBy: item 22 slice 7 — thread the registrar host set into the two isTrustedDocumentHost call sites and reset the cache per cycle
unwired.impact: a document served by a legitimate registrar is still refused, because the second parameter is never supplied and its default is an empty set. loadRegistrarDocumentHosts() and resetRegistrarDocumentHostsCache() already exist and work; nothing calls them.
